A vast upgrade from its predecessor, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 takes the EXP-MX0402-010 features to new heights, whilst maintaining its cost effect platform. Keeping up with the latest standards, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 has been upgraded to an 18Gbps backbone with HDCP 2.2 compliance and now featuring a powerful built-in auto scaler on both of its outputs allowing users to simultaneously connect a mix of 4K and 1080p displays.

If that wasn’t enough, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 also includes analog and digital audio de-embed and ARC, as well as CEC triggering and RS-232 control, hosting a boat load of control features. Coupled with the WyreStorm TS-280 touchscreen and HAOC line of HDMI cables makes for the perfect power pack solution for mid to large scale residential and light commercial applications!

Aside from the front panel pushbuttons and IR, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 is now equipped with powerful API for RS-232 control. This API gives the user access to advanced functions not typically found in this price range, which include video control, audio mute, CEC triggering EDID settings and basic troubleshooting, just to name a few. Coupled with the TS-280, it makes control a breeze!

The EXP-MX-0402-H2 has the best of not only video in mind, but audio as well. Built to supply any sound system, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 can output analog audio to an amp or speaker system and 5.1 audio to an AVR. Furthermore, a gear selector on output 2 allows ARC to travel back from a smart display to a soundbar or AVR for the best audio and video experience possible!

Sporting an 18Gbps HDMI backplane, the EXP-MX-0402-H2 shares big brother bandwidths, supporting all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high frame-rate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz, along with multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos.
